hooks.command: TTY=$(ps -p $PPID -o tty= | tr -d ' '); [ -n "$TTY" ] && [ "$TTY" != '??' ] && printf '\e]9;Claude is waiting\007' > /dev/$TTY
TTY=$(ps -p $PPID -o tty= | tr -d ' '); [ -n "$TTY" ] && [ "$TTY" != '??' ] && printf '\e]9;Claude needs approval\007' > /dev/$TTY

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir_full=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir=$(basename "$dir_full"); branch=$(git -C "$dir_full" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); YLW=$(printf '\033[33m'); RED=$(printf '\033[31m'); CYN=$(printf '\033[36m'); GRN=$(printf '\033[95m'); RST=$(printf '\033[0m'); bar(){ p=$1; w=20; f=$((p*w/100)); e=$((w-f)); b=""; i=0; while [ $i -lt $f ]; do b="${b}█"; i=$((i+1)); done; i=0; while [ $i -lt $e ]; do b="${b}░"; i=$((i+1)); done; if [ "$p" -ge 90 ]; then printf '%s%s %3d%%%s' "$RED" "$b" "$p" "$RST"; elif [ "$p" -ge 80 ]; then printf '%s%s %3d%%%s' "$YLW" "$b" "$p" "$RST"; else printf '%s %3d%%' "$b" "$p"; fi; }; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then echo "$model | ${CYN}$dir${RST} (${GRN}$branch${RST})"; else echo "$model | ${CYN}$dir${RST}"; fi; if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then p=$(printf '%.0f' "$ctx"); echo "ctx  $(bar $p)"; fi; if [ -n "$five" ]; then p=$(printf '%.0f' "$five"); echo "5h   $(bar $p)"; fi; if [ -n "$week" ]; then p=$(printf '%.0f' "$week"); echo "7d   $(bar $p)"; fi
